Anada includes third-party software and fonts.

This folder preserves their copyright and license notices. manifest.json identifies
the pinned source packages, their declared licenses, notice paths and upstream URLs.
The manifest conservatively includes dependencies for other platforms and build/test
tools as well as libraries used by the Windows binaries. Inclusion in the manifest
does not mean that every listed package is present in the installed executable.

crates/ contains library and bundled-font notices. rust/ contains the Rust standard
library notices. rust-gnu-runtime/ and mingw/ preserve GNU runtime exception and
MinGW notices. No third-party license grants rights to Anada's own source code.

Virtual Audio Cable is separate software licensed by its vendor. Its unchanged
optional trial archive contains its own license and installation documentation.
